Now I have a complete understanding of the project structure and data. Let me create a comprehensive analysis report.

## Full File Contents Summary

### 1. ProjectDetailContent.tsx (563 lines)
This is the main detail page renderer that displays:
- Project type tag (PENTAGRAM STYLE - subtle, no background)
- Title (Lora serif italic, editorial style)
- Metadata line: Year • Client • Role
- **My Role** section with role title + shot count + responsibilities
- Full video player (EmbeddedVideoPlayer)
- Description text
- **Project Details** toggle section containing:
  - Intent
  - Challenge
  - Approach
  - Reference
  - Credits (child of Process, with border separator)
- Breakdown videos (Behind the Scenes sections)
- Related work (filtered by discipline overlap, excludes current/adjacent projects)
- Project navigation (Previous/Next with arrow links)

### 2. [slug]/page.tsx (96 lines)
Server-side route handler that:
- Imports both `projects` and `genAiProjects` arrays
- Renders `ProjectHeroReel` (autoplay, fixed position at top)
- Renders `ProjectContentWrapper` with `ProjectDetailContent` inside
- Handles metadata generation for SEO

### 3. ProjectCard.tsx (108 lines)
Grid card component displaying:
- VideoThumbnail (hover-to-play)
- Title (Lora italic, 22-28px)
- gridDescription (optional, secondary text)
- Client name (optional, metadata footer)
- No category tags

### 4. VideoThumbnail.tsx (352 lines)
Robust hover-to-play system with:
- Static thumbnail (60% opacity + desaturated on idle)
- Hover-triggered video initialization (12s timeout max)
- Single active video enforcement via manager
- AbortController-based cancellation
- Touch device detection (static thumbnail only on mobile)
- Retry mechanism on init failure
- Clean state reset on mouse leave

### 5. projects.ts (569 lines)
The data file with:
- **Project Interface** (70 properties available)
- **13 project entries** with varying data density

---
